intro.title: Ages Unwound
intro.body: Ages Unwound is a seven-part fan-made campaign for Arkham Horror: The Card Game, designed by Olivia Juliet, in which the investigators are unstuck from their own timeline and must bind the time-god Aforgomon before every age collapses into one.

additionalRulesAndClarifications.title: Additional Rules and Clarifications
additionalRulesAndClarifications.alert: TODO(ages-unwound): the printed Alert rules text. Mechanically: if you fail a skill test while attempting to evade an *Alert* enemy, after that test resolves that enemy attacks you. It does not exhaust, and this happens whether or not you are engaged with it.
additionalRulesAndClarifications.storyCards: TODO(ages-unwound): the printed Story card rules text. Resolve the story text and then the game text; a story card is usually the reverse of another card.
additionalRulesAndClarifications.gainingAndLosingActions: TODO(ages-unwound): the printed Gaining and Losing Actions rules text. A *standard action* is any action without a limitation on its use, regardless of source. Gained actions are granted in upkeep (4.2).

riggedToBlow.moveOne: Move one investigator at your location to a connecting location
riggedToBlow.moveEach: Move each investigator at your location to a connecting location

unevenAcceleration.gainActionAndDraw: Gain an action. Draw the top card of the encounter deck

timeReshaped.loseActionForSkill: Lose 1 action. You get +1 skill value during skill tests until the end of the round
timeReshaped.gainActionForSkill: Gain 1 action. You get –1 skill value during skill tests until the end of the round

timesEbb.doNotChoose: Do not choose an investigator. Lose an action

schemeOfTheMyriad.investigate: Harness the tear in reality instead of discovering clues

bookHeist.steal: Wait for your moment, then swoop in and grab it
bookHeist.notWorthTheRisk: It's just not worth the risk

answers.knowledge: “Knowledge.” Draw cards until you reach your maximum hand size
answers.power: “Power.” Distribute 5 supplies, ammo, charges or secrets among assets you control
answers.aid: “Aid.” Move to any location and deal 3 damage to an enemy there

windowOfOpportunity.retreat: You retreat, while you still have that option
windowOfOpportunity.digSite: You move toward the dig site, determined to seal this thing back where it came from

agencyStrikeTeam.damageEachEnemy: Deal 3 damage to each enemy at the chosen location
agencyStrikeTeam.discoverClues: Discover 3 clues at the chosen location

aMultitudeOfPlots.placeDoom: Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This card gains surge and is removed from the game
aMultitudeOfPlots.addToVictory: Add this card to the victory display, advancing the plans of the Myriad

childrensPlayground.spendActions: Spend actions to lower Children's Playground's shroud for this investigation

assistanceFromTheLodge.dealDamage: “Something moves in the dark beyond, and your foe drops.” Deal 2 damage to an enemy
assistanceFromTheLodge.discoverClue: “A note, slipped into your pocket you don't remember.” Discover a clue from your location or a connecting location
assistanceFromTheLodge.healDamage: “A sting, a bandage, and the pain recedes.” Heal 2 damage

frontHallway.haunted: If the Hound of Unmaking is in play and undamaged, place 1 damage on it

cafeteria.haunted: Lose all remaining actions and end your turn
cafeteria.investigate: Investigate. If you fail, do not trigger this location’s haunted ability

classroomGuardedSecrets.haunted: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Criminal enemy and draw it

classroomEnergisedAndUnstable.haunted: For each standard action you have remaining, either lose 1 action or take 1 direct damage

principalsOffice.haunted: For each action you have completed this turn, take 1 horror or choose and discard a card from your hand

ritualCircleAHarnessedFuture.haunted: Suspend your current turn and remove your investigator from the game. At the start of the next investigator phase, return your investigator to this location and resume the current turn

schemeOfTheMyriad.investigate: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, flip Scheme of the Myriad over and resolve its text

arkhamMassachusetts.helpingYourself: Investigators at this location spend 2 clues per investigator, as a group: Remove 1 resource from Helping Yourself
arkhamMassachusetts.resign: Resign. You return to Arkham, ready for what is to come

mexicoCity.gainClues: Discard an Item asset you control: Gain 2 clues from the token pool

istanbul.heal: Spend 2 resources: Heal 1 damage and 1 horror
istanbul.move: Spend 2 resources: Move to a connecting location

cairo.search: Search the top 3 cards of your deck for a card and draw it

shanghai.move: Move to San Francisco or Sydney
shanghai.gainClue: Spend 3 resources: Gain 1 clue from the token pool

sydney.move: Move to San Francisco or Shanghai
sydney.replenish: Place 4 clues on Sydney. Draw 2 cards and gain 2 resources. Move to any other location

displacedLegion.parley: Parley. Test {intellect} (4) to communicate with the soldiers. If you succeed, until the end of the round, Displaced Legion loses massive and gains aloof
displacedLegion.portal: Test {willpower} (4) to open a portal through time. If you succeed, add Displaced Legion to the victory display

theLongGame.drawTask: The investigators spend 1 clue per investigator, as a group: Put the top card of the Task deck into play next to the act deck, resolving its revelation effect

ritualCircleThePresentFractured.haunted: Haunted – Take 1 damage and 1 horror. Place 1 of your clues on Ritual Circle. Gain an action, which can only be used to investigate Ritual Circle.
